about: Canonical renders (render recipes) that every renderer / asset / rig change is compared against. References live in the gitignored store (<library_store>/goldens/refs); their hashes and metrics are in factory/goldens/baseline.json. See factory/lessons/README.md.

hero_turnaround.rubric: hero model appeal and silhouette from front, side and back: proportions, wardrobe detail, no broken geometry

hero_pose_sheet.rubric: pose quality: balance, weight, natural hands (relaxed curl, never splayed), seated pelvis on the seat, upright or forward spine

hero_face_sheet.rubric: each expression reads instantly and appealingly (brows, lids, mouth corners, slight asymmetry); upper lid covers the top of the iris unless fear/shock

yacht_turnaround.rubric: yacht detail: bevels, real sub-parts, material variation; reads as a hero asset in medium shots

sentinel_A01a.rubric: establishing shot: the lone yacht at night, clear silhouette, cinematic moonlight

sentinel_A02.rubric: hero at the helm: readable face, not brown (camera outside geometry), motivated light

sentinel_B11.rubric: aground on the reef: story context, hero pose, surf

sentinel_C13.rubric: Mayday close-up: radio in hand (palm contact), face framed forehead-to-chin, emotion reads

sentinel_C21.rubric: stay with your boat: hero + boat + island context, consistent key

sentinel_E31.rubric: dawn escape: tide lift, warm dawn key, hero at the helm (D23-D26 primrose set shots do not render: unknown world kit primrose)

kit_jungle_clearing.rubric: jungle clearing set: depth, firelight, readable hero

kit_desert_canyon.rubric: desert canyon set: scale, warm light, readable hero

kit_snow_mountain_ridge.lib_note: full library OOMs (>15 GB cgroup) with the fir scatter; curated keeps the set build without the heavy scatter
kit_snow_mountain_ridge.rubric: snow ridge set: exposure on snow, cold palette, readable hero

kit_abandoned_city_street.rubric: abandoned street set: practicals, depth, readable hero
